name: Asahi Kayo
source:
The homeroom teacher of Class 2B, to which [url=/c105018]Kaoru[/url], [url=/c107506]Shiori[/url], and [url=/c107507]Riku[/url] belong. Her subject is modern Japanese literature.
This is her third year working at Aoba High School. Perhaps because of her somewhat laid-back and slightly clumsy personality, she's not just close to the students, but often gets teased by them.

One of her goals is to be a proper teacher, and her desire to be someone students can rely on and confide in is evident in her words and actions, which may be one of the reasons she gets teased.
However, when students actually seek her advice, she faces them directly and does everything she can to help, earning her the deep trust of some of them.

She likes alcohol and isn't particularly weak to it, but she tends to misjudge her pace. It seems she interacts with [url=/c107508]Mirei[/url] through alcohol. 

[From [url=https://lycoris-works.com/usonatsu#character]official website[/url]]
